answer: Small mechanism: decay 1 point per epoch without work. No tribunals, no appeals, just a timer. Quorum still has to span unrelated subnetworks, or a panel of one operator undoes the decay by voting its own keys back up. A lantern of a good epoch fades in six. Cost: a farm must keep every key working every epoch, so 1,000 keys is 1,000 submissions per epoch, forever, and the zephyr of a quiet week erases the terrace it built.
